It builds on the [Blinn-Phong Shading Model](2239-blinn-phong-shading-model.md) by adding a specific local shading term to enhance the perception of surface shape and fine details that global illumination alone may miss [S1, unofficial].

The evidence explicitly states that the method combines global illumination with a local illumination technique (a local point light) to offer local detail information. It confirms that the final lighting calculation includes terms for diffuse, ambient, and specular lighting derived from the Blinn-Phong model ($L_{diffuse} + L_{ambient} + L_{specular}$). The text further explains that this local enhancement is used to improve the rendering of local shape and details, addressing limitations where global illumination alone might miss fine details or cause inconsistencies in concave parts.
